commit.subject: watchdog: bound retained closed cache
commit.body:
Cap the aggregate retained object graph at 16 MiB, compact scanned closed entries, and evict to re-read without losing mutation or once state. Stream job enumeration so parsed payloads do not accumulate across the store.

Source: original
Co-Authored-By: GPT-5.6 Sol <noreply@openai.com>
